Title: My already-open route loads with its stops
Preconditions: a published route whose `is_route_open` is 1 (so the call writes nothing)
Steps: 1. pick such a route from `routelist` 2. POST `simplerouteview` with `route_id`

Title: Another user's route is not returned (S3.8)
Preconditions: the Business Sales Agent owns an already-open route
Steps: 1. confirm, as the Business Sales Agent, that its route loads 2. POST `simplerouteview` with that `route_id` **as the Sales Agent** (a non-owner call never writes)
Expected result: the owner gets the route; the other user gets no stops. **Today the non-owner receives the same `route_details` as the owner** (runtime 2026-09-16, known gap UI-SEC-11)
